originalRequest: Check this design and unslop it. Here are some refference pictures how it should look
subject: POLIDS, an existing web-based ATC information display for VATSIM Poland (EPWW FIR) modeled on the PANDORA system: tabs RADIO, METEO, AERODROME, AD CIV/MIL/VFR, CALLSIGN, AIRCRAFT, REGISTRATION, MAP, COORDINATION, CONVERSION, SYT OP, AUP, AWALON, INOP, EMERGENCY, OTHER, ABOUT, ADMIN.
scope: Visual cleanup of the existing app shell and shared tab content styles (frontend/css/style.css plus per-tab CSS) so it matches the PANDORA references more closely. No new features, tabs or data; keep layouts, data and behavior.
primaryGoal: Remove generic, AI-looking styling and make every screen read like the real PANDORA console: dense, flat, legible, black-and-green, data first.
audience: VATSIM controllers working Polish positions (ACC/APP/TWR/FIS), often on a second monitor at 1366x768 or 1920x1080, touch or mouse.
offer: Fast one-touch access to all operational reference data (meteo, frequencies, aerodromes, aircraft, procedures) in a familiar PANDORA-style layout.
primaryAction: Select a menu tab, then a submenu item, to view the data instantly.
creativeControl: Low: follow the PANDORA references and existing project decisions closely; refine, do not reinvent.
requiredContent: Left menu column: full-width green rectangular buttons, uppercase labels, brighter green for active item, red EMERGENCY button, as in references 1, 2, 10, 11
Submenu column: second green button column (METAR PL ... MF, A-Z letter grid for AIRCRAFT/CALLSIGN) as in references 3, 7, 10
Top strip: thin Reload | Brighter | Darker bar (existing)

METEO content: dense METAR/TAF rows on black, white text with yellow CAVOK/highlights and dim green RMK/time groups, alternating faint row bands (reference 3); raw GAMET/TAF text blocks (reference 11)
QNH and map views: black or paper-white map panels with thin lines and yellow/white values (references 4, 10); satellite image panel with caption below (reference 5)
RADIO board: frequency boxes as white rectangles with dark text, cyan unit labels, yellow sector tags on black (reference 6)
AIRCRAFT view: white performance sheet with photo and spec table next to the letter grid (reference 7)
AERODROME list: wide uppercase list with red full-row highlight for selection, search field and on-screen keyboard (reference 8)
EMERGENCY procedures: heading, uppercase bullet lists, red screen frame (reference 9)
ABOUT: plain text version/credits block on black (reference 2)
Interaction transitions: only instant or very short state changes on tab/submenu switches, row hover/selection; no decorative motion
constraints: Keep Arial/sans-serif regular weight everywhere, no bold emphasis, color for emphasis (owner decision, issue #23)
Sharp corners: border-radius 0 except true circles
No glow, text shadows, gradients-for-decoration or card shadows
Fixed button metrics: 137x28 px buttons, 1.5 px margins, 150 px columns (issue #25)
Must work at 1366x768 and 1920x1080 and on touch
Do not change data, APIs, tab structure or JS behavior
Original PANDORA logo/branding must not be copied; use POLIDS identity
brandInputs: Typography: Arial / Liberation Sans regular via --mono, --ui, --sans (style.css)
Visual style: PANDORA (PAŻP) green-on-black buttons plus EUROCONTROL NM UI dense panels (style.css header comment)
Reference screenshots 1-11 supplied by user (PANDORA promo video)
assumptions: 'This design' means the current POLIDS frontend in this repo, so pageType is dashboard
'Unslop' means remove generic web-app styling (rounded cards, soft shadows, NM-UI panel chrome where PANDORA is flatter, inconsistent spacing) and align with the reference screens
Existing owner decisions (Arial, no bold, sharp corners, button sizes) take precedence over anything in the references that differs
References come from a 2016 promo video; perspective, blur and video subtitles are ignored
Motion limited to quick functional state changes, since operational console use favors instant response
unresolved: Whether EUROCONTROL NM UI panel title bars should stay or be flattened fully to PANDORA style; default: keep but simplify
